# Air hockey table, phase 2: materials (exact SLSO-CLR17 sRGB), the rink texture on the playing
# surface, hidden faces deleted (bottoms, faces buried in the body or under the rails), the coin
# plate inset, join, flat shading, export. Run after p1_blockout.txt. Generated by make_table.py.
material new Rink --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Rink base-color textures/rink.png
material new Cap --base-color 0.9176 0.3804 0.6157 --no-slot
material new Rail --base-color 0.5608 0.2392 0.6549 --no-slot
material new Body --base-color 0.2431 0.2549 0.3725 --no-slot
material new Pocket --base-color 0.1804 0.1725 0.2314 --no-slot
material new Leg --base-color 0.3333 0.3765 0.4902 --no-slot
material new Coin --base-color 0.9529 0.7608 0.1255 --no-slot
select Surface
active Surface
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object

select Surface
material assign Rink

select CapF CapB CapLF CapLB CapRF CapRB
material assign Cap

select BaseF BaseB BaseLF BaseLB BaseRF BaseRB
material assign Rail

select Body Coin
material assign Body

select PocketL PocketR
material assign Pocket

select Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3
material assign Leg

select Body
active Body
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg0
active Leg0
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg1
active Leg1
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg2
active Leg2
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg3
active Leg3
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select BaseF
active BaseF
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select BaseB
active BaseB
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select BaseLF
active BaseLF
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select BaseLB
active BaseLB
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select BaseRF
active BaseRF
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select BaseRB
active BaseRB
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CapF
active CapF
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CapB
active CapB
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CapLF
active CapLF
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CapLB
active CapLB
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CapRF
active CapRF
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CapRB
active CapRB
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select PocketL
active PocketL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select PocketR
active PocketR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Coin
active Coin
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
inset 0.09
material assign Coin
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Surface Body BaseF CapF BaseB CapB BaseLF CapLF BaseLB CapLB BaseRF CapRF BaseRB CapRB PocketL PocketR Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3 Coin
active Body
join
rename Body Table

shade flat
export table.glb
